# `get_calib_frame`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the calibration frame selection (file name, enable flag, size) for one or all frame types.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (the handler itself only reads state; the grade reflects the shared diagnostic log writes made by every full call) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, get_calib_frame @0xbe690, GetCalibrateFrame @0x193510 (only caller is this handler); LoadCalibFile @0x3bace0, HasCalibFlatFiles @0x3b8fa0, GetFlatBiasFileName @0x3b8d30; LSC calibration_s30p_s50p_lsc_img @0x1bed50 (no reporting path) |

Copies stored calibration metadata without reading any FITS file. With no selector it returns dark, bias and flat entries; with a selector the three members of that type appear directly in the result. Entries are reported even for an empty name or a disabled frame. The result is the stored selection only; it does not show which bias and flat files the frame-read calibration has loaded (fixed names in the customer or default library), and nothing reports the wide-camera lens-shading correction.

Side effects: None beyond the shared diagnostic log writes. Copies calibration metadata and the hot simulate flag; no FITS read or hardware activity.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_calib_frame"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Optional frame-type selector: a string (dark, bias or flat), or an array whose first element is that string. Absent params or an empty array selects all types. An explicit null, non-string or object gives 105. light and unknown strings give 209. There is no object-key form. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | Selector present but not a string | `expected string param` |
| 209 | Unknown or light selector | `invalid value` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, all:

```json
{"id":43,"method":"get_calib_frame"}
```

Request, one - Selector form:

```json
{"id":44,"method":"get_calib_frame","params":"dark"}
```

Reply, all-ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_calib_frame","result":{"simulate":false,"dark":{"frame_name":"example_dark.fit","enable":true,"frame_size":[1080,1920]},"bias":{"frame_name":"","enable":false,"frame_size":[0,0]},"flat":{"frame_name":"","enable":false,"frame_size":[0,0]}},"code":0,"id":43}
```

Reply, one-ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_calib_frame","result":{"simulate":false,"frame_name":"example_dark.fit","enable":true,"frame_size":[1080,1920]},"code":0,"id":44}
```
